text.content: 13. Distribution strategy — YouTube as a search engine (LOCKED)

rich_text.plain_text: 13. Distribution strategy — YouTube as a search engine (LOCKED)

text.content: The YouTube paradox: we picked a reach engine but optimized for a niche. YouTube's algorithm rewards broad watch-time, so a narrow buyer-first channel can make great videos almost nobody sees. Resolution: treat YouTube as a SEARCH engine, not a virality / slot-machine. Rank for the exact questions founders already type ('should I build a custom app or just use Zapier', 'how to use AI for sales', 'AI to review sales calls'). Fewer views per video, but the viewer arrived WITH intent — which is exactly conversion-over-size. Title the video as the query, not as a curiosity hook.

text.content: Center of gravity = the HIGH-TICKET, sophisticated, can-invest buyer (RF ICP: founder-led ~$3–20M operators + their revenue leaders; people already 'in the sauce'). Write TO this person, and pitch content at their sophistication level so beginners self-filter. Early-stage / beginners are explicitly NOT the target — at most they'd buy a cheap course, which is a different (worse-for-Lloyd) model he is declining; the channel is not built to help someone 'just set up their Claude Code.' Enterprise execs = credibility amplifiers + occasional referrers, not the center (the fractional-CAIRO offer fits them less). Broad audience is welcome spillover; the DESIGN target is the buyer.
